facts.claim: Context Foundry v1 already encoded the core invariant that context is selected rather than automatically participating: records carry authority/privacy/source lineage, role/tag filters select a bounded set, authority orders results and LOCAL/non-exportable context fails closed on export.

Context Foundry v2.1 materially strengthens that substrate: immutable byte/context registries, declared authority ordering including SOURCE_REFERENCE and RAW_UNCURATED, lineage-derived privacy, currentness and superseded_by filtering, role/tag/query relevance scoring, deterministic authority/id tie-breaks, explicit exclusions, high-authority claim conflict detection, privacy-aware external selection, consumption receipts and reopen handles/source refs.
The existing intake layer already normalizes raw material as RAW_UNCURATED, requires a stable raw id, validates privacy and requires source_ref before it can enter the foundry.

The note-atom validator already fails on duplicate identity, missing claim/authority fields, invalid privacy and conflicting CURRENT atoms for one claim key; this is a reusable precedent for source-card identity and contamination/conflict tests.

Durable continuity already states EXISTS != PARTICIPATES and privacy inheritance as active invariants, while HOT context is pointer-oriented and explicitly avoids embedding private literal payload. The Source Plane should preserve those invariants rather than becoming a dump of all stored material.

WI-BIG-01 independently recovered R70/source-plane semantics as indexed/retrievable/curated memory selected into the smallest sufficient Working Set with authority/privacy awareness and reopenable provenance. Its durable return is now COMPLETE, so this scout no longer has an unresolved execution dependency on WI-BIG-01; parent still owns convergence between the two candidates.

end_to_end_pipeline.principle: Keep storage, admissibility, selection and compilation as separate reproducible stages. A source existing in storage never implies participation in a Working Set or compiled program.
stages: RAW_SOURCE: captured bytes/text/event with source_ref, capture identity, observed/ingested time and inherited privacy; authority begins RAW_UNCURATED unless a higher authority is independently established.

SOURCE_CARD: normalized immutable metadata/evidence envelope for one source revision. Minimum identity: source_id, revision_id/content_digest, source_ref/reopen_handle, source kind, produced_at/observed_at/ingested_at, authority, privacy, scope/tags, provenance/lineage, currentness, supersedes/superseded_by or heir_ref, and optional claim/evidence slots.
SOURCE_REGISTRY_INDEX: append-only/addressable cards plus current-heir pointers and search/index features. Registry presence is EXISTS only; it does not grant participation or authority.

RETRIEVAL_RECEIPT: deterministic query result after hard admissibility filters and relevance ranking. It records query/task/evidence slots, candidate revision ids, selected ids, rejected/deferred ids with reasons, conflicts, freshness mode, budgets and exact index/head identity.

WORKING_SET_MANIFEST: bounded explicit set of exact selected source revisions plus retrieval receipt, required evidence slots, coverage state, rejected/deferred reasons, privacy ceiling, conflicts and size/token budget. It is the canonical proof of what PARTICIPATES for one task/run.

COMPILED_PROGRAM: deterministic compilation from task/method + Working Set into the executable context/program. It records exact Working Set identity, included evidence/source refs, unresolved coverage, privacy/export target and compiler identity; it must not erase provenance or manufacture closure for missing evidence.

identity: source_id is stable across revisions; revision_id/content_digest identifies exact replayable material.
source_ref/reopen_handle must be sufficient to reopen the authoritative source or byte record; copied prose is not source identity.
derived cards carry lineage_ids/source_refs to exact upstream source revisions and inherit the strongest privacy unless an explicit trusted redaction/declassification receipt exists.
freshness: Represent produced_at, observed_at and ingested_at separately; do not infer freshness from file version/commit recency alone.
A source may declare fresh_until/ttl or a domain freshness policy. Expiry makes it stale for fresh-mode retrieval but does not delete historical replayability.
supersedes/superseded_by or current_heir_ref is explicit. Fresh resolution follows the admissible authoritative heir; historical replay preserves the exact recorded revision.
When freshness cannot be determined for a freshness-required evidence slot, fail/mark UNKNOWN rather than silently treating the source as fresh.
authority: Reuse the Context Foundry authority ladder rather than inventing recency-as-authority. Authority is independently declared/derived from source owner/type and may only change through explicit evidence/decision.
Same-scope high-authority contradictory CURRENT claims fail closed or surface a conflict; lower-authority material may contextualize but cannot silently overwrite higher-authority truth.
Retrieval receipts must record both selected authority and relevant higher-authority exclusions/conflicts.
relevance: Relevance is task/evidence-slot scoped, not a permanent property of a source. Hard eligibility is evaluated before soft relevance ranking.
Use deterministic ranking/tie-breaks for replay; semantic/embedding ranking can be a later optimization but cannot remove admissibility/exclusion receipts.
privacy: Privacy is monotone through lineage: derived cards and Working Sets inherit the strongest source restriction unless a trusted exact-scope redaction/declassification receipt authorizes a lower classification.
External compilation/export filters privacy before ranking/selection and fails closed on unauthorized material; opaque possession of a source handle is not declassification.

retrieval_and_reuse_semantics: HARD FILTER ORDER: requested/required ids -> access/privacy -> requested historical/fresh mode -> currentness/supersession/heir -> minimum authority/domain constraints -> role/scope eligibility. Only then score relevance and apply budget.
Every selected source revision has an inclusion reason; every high-relevance excluded/cutoff source has a rejection reason. Missing explicit ids fail closed.
REPLAY(source_id, revision_id or retrieval/working-set receipt) means reproduce the exact historical selection/material even if a newer heir exists, subject to current access policy.
REFRESH(source_id or semantic query) means resolve current admissible heirs under current freshness/authority/privacy rules and may produce a different receipt.
Reuse by copied text or detached summary is not source reuse. Reusable derived summaries are themselves source cards with lineage back to exact covered revisions/watermarks.

minimum_fields: required evidence slots and slot->source coverage mapping
working_set_contract.sufficiency_rule: For every required evidence slot r, the Working Set must contain at least one admissible source revision satisfying r's authority, freshness, privacy/access and scope constraints, OR r must be explicitly UNSATISFIED/WAIVED with a reason and waiving authority. Absence must never be converted into implied knowledge.
working_set_contract.minimality_rule: After sufficiency is reached, additional sources participate only when they add required coverage, resolve/represent a material conflict, satisfy a diversity/independence requirement, or are explicitly pinned. This preserves smallest-sufficient context rather than maximal retrieval.

contamination_definition.admissible_source: A source revision is admissible only if access/privacy permits its target use, requested freshness mode accepts it, currentness/supersession policy accepts it, required authority floor accepts it, and it is relevant to at least one declared task/evidence slot or explicit pin.
contamination_definition.clean_working_set: A Working Set is uncontaminated only if every participating source is admissible, no unauthorized privacy downgrade occurred, no superseded/stale source is silently used in fresh mode, and no omitted higher-authority contradictory source is hidden without a conflict marker/rejection reason.
contamination_definition.compiled_program_rule: Compilation may compress/transform evidence but must preserve enough lineage to prove every source-backed claim/recommendation that requires evidence and must preserve UNSATISFIED/conflict markers.

proof_and_regression_suite: DETERMINISTIC_RETRIEVAL: same registry head + query/evidence slots + policy + budget yields identical ordered selected/rejected revisions and receipt digest.
AUTHORITY_CONFLICT: conflicting CURRENT high-authority cards for one claim fail closed or surface an explicit unresolved conflict; lower authority never wins silently.
FRESH_HEIR: a stale/superseded revision is rejected in fresh mode when an admissible heir exists; historical replay still reopens the exact old revision.
UNKNOWN_FRESHNESS: a freshness-required slot with no provable freshness remains UNSATISFIED/UNKNOWN rather than passing.
PRIVACY_NON_DOWNGRADE: LOCAL-derived material remains LOCAL through source card -> Working Set -> compiled program unless an exact trusted declassification/redaction receipt is supplied.
SUFFICIENCY_GAP: removing the only admissible source for a required evidence slot causes sufficiency failure and visible UNSATISFIED state.
CONTAMINATION: inject irrelevant, unauthorized, stale/superseded or below-authority-floor sources; each must be rejected or cause the Working Set proof to fail.
OMITTED_CONFLICT: exclude a known higher-authority contradictory source; contamination/conflict audit must fail unless the omission is explicitly justified and recorded.
REUSE_STABILITY: after publishing a new heir, replaying an old receipt resolves the old revision while REFRESH resolves the new heir; the two modes are never conflated.
LINEAGE_CLOSURE: every selected derived card and every compiled source-backed assertion can be traversed to reopenable source revisions/bytes with no dangling lineage ref.
BUDGET_MINIMALITY: after required coverage is satisfied, unrelated extra records do not participate; budget cutoff is explicit and deterministic.
PROMPT/COMPILER_ERASURE: summarization/compilation that drops required source refs, conflicts or UNSATISFIED markers fails validation rather than yielding an apparently complete program.
